opus.why: Read a short build log and rate three common warnings (missing useEffect dep, unused import, chunk size). Routine triage that Haiku handles well.

fable.why: Reading a short build log and judging which warnings matter (stale useEffect dependency vs cosmetic unused import / chunk size / browserslist). Simple explanation; medium so the useEffect risk is called out rather than glossed over.

opus.why: List the existing script files in the project. Simple file lookup.

fable.why: List existing script files in the studio project: a glob/ls and a short summary. No judgment needed.

opus.why: Final brand slogans the audience will read. Getting a warm, ironic tone without pathos is subtle creative work where quality drops show, but the output is short.

fable.why: Final brand copy: five English slogans that must land the warm/ironic tone and avoid banned words. Short taglines are where craft shows most; Opus gives noticeably sharper, less generic options.

opus.why: A race condition in a payment webhook that double-charges users. Needs a correct idempotency design (unique constraint, transaction or locking) plus concurrency tests. Money and correctness are critical.

fable.why: Concurrency bug in real-money code: needs correct idempotency design (unique provider id + transaction/lock), coverage of both retries and parallel requests, plus tests that actually reproduce the race. Correctness of financial logic justifies Opus; file is provided so high suffices.

opus.why: Small targeted edit to an image-generation prompt (hands, mug resting on the table) while keeping the rest. Standard prompt craft, well within Sonnet's range.

fable.why: Targeted edit of an image-generation prompt: fix hand anatomy and cup placement while preserving the rest. Well-specified visual prompt tweak; Sonnet handles this craft without quality loss.

opus.why: Minimal legal rewording of privacy-policy clauses in Russian, plus correct GDPR article references (Art. 6/13/5(1)(e), rights in Arts. 15–22). Legal precision matters, but the scope is small.

fable.why: Legal copy the audience reads plus GDPR accuracy (lawful bases, Art. 13/15-22, storage limitation). Minimal-promise wording and a lawyer-facing clarity rewrite need precision Sonnet may miss.

opus.why: A 60-second Reels script, shot by shot, with a hook and CTA. Final audience copy where the strength of the hook and the writing matter.

fable.why: Final reels script: hook quality, tight 60-second pacing, shot-by-shot breakdown in Russian with bilingual on-screen text. Audience-facing creative copy where weaker models produce generic results.

opus.why: Architecture decision on multi-tenancy (RLS vs schema-per-tenant vs separate DBs) with isolation needs, plus a zero-downtime migration plan covering backfill, ORM and rollback. Complex systems design where errors are costly.

fable.why: Architecture and security decision: compare tenancy models for ~200 tenants with isolation demands, then a zero-downtime migration plan covering backfill, ORM query safety, RLS and rollback. Deep multi-part reasoning; xhigh for thoroughness across all parts.

opus.why: Merge a PR already verified as green. A simple git action.

fable.why: Follow-up to an already-verified PR check; the action is a single git merge of the reviewed branch into main. Trivial command execution.
